study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
cohort: Women with one prior cesarean from the Cesarean Registry, a prospective cohort study of women undergoing cesarean between 1999 and 2002
finding: Prior unlabored cesarean is associated with an increased risk of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders in a subsequent pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women with prior unlabored cesarean had a higher risk of subsequent PAS disorders compared to women with a prior labored cesarean.
